{
 "path": "programs/task-7792d510.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==2 and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            if len(cells)!=4: continue
            rows={}
            for y,x in cells: rows[y]=rows.get(y,0)+1
            bars=[y for y,n in rows.items() if n==3]
            stems=[y for y,n in rows.items() if n==1]
            if len(bars)!=1 or len(stems)!=1: continue
            cy=sum(y for y,x in cells)/4
            cx=sum(x for y,x in cells)/4
            color=3 if stems[0]<bars[0] else 1
            objects.append((cy,cx,color))
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    for cy,cx,color in objects:
        oy=min(2,int(cy*3/h))
        ox=min(5,int(cx*6/w))
        out[oy][ox]=color
    return out
"
